description: MUTATES Codat data — create a new company (a container for a customer's data connections). Provide a name; optionally a description, tags, or other attributes via `fields`. Codat API: POST /companies. Returns the created company (incl. its id).

description.description: Optional description / notes for the company.

fields.description: Additional raw Codat fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).

name.description: A human-readable name for the company (usually your customer's business name).

name: codat_create_company
title: Create a company
